_provenance.description: Verbatim GOV-347 Stage 3.05 card-feed capture for the reviewer-internal Alpine timeline (GOV-354). Produced by running scripts/stage3_card_feed.py at backend origin/main HEAD 6d65bd3 against a real seeded reviewer-internal Alpine corpus DB. Pure re-projection of the already-web-safe Stage 2 read surface: same DB -> byte-identical feed (no AI, no network, no client re-derivation).
_provenance.capture_method: python3 scripts/stage3_card_feed.py --db <real reviewer-internal Alpine corpus DB>  (GOV-347/#63 at backend HEAD 6d65bd3); stdout captured verbatim, then this _provenance block prepended.
_provenance.envelope: {scope, access, cards[]} per Docs/stage3-05-card-feed-contract.md (GOV-346) and the GOV-353 frontend contract (docs/stage3-06-card-feed-frontend-contract.md)
_provenance.present_card_note: All present cards in this seed corpus are type=ai_presented (machine-extracted, unreviewed) — they render gated/labeled in the AI region, never as verified fact. Other present types (statement/meeting/decision/source/correction) and the verified/corrected statuses are exercised by the GOV-354 adapter unit tests with synthetic cards until the reviewed corpus promotes non-AI present cards.
_provenance.title_field_note: This envelope (HEAD 6d65bd3) emits no `title` key on present cards; the surface renders title present-only (omitted, never invented) per the GOV-353 contract bounded-gap rule.
_provenance.raw_path_sweep: CLEAN — zero raw-marker / forbidden-key hits in the serialized body (frontend assertWebSafe + RAW_PATH_FORBIDDEN_KEYS); the backend already swept it via read_api.assert_no_raw_paths (AC-3).
_provenance.access: reviewer_internal — gated-beta lane only, not owner-published; no public projection.
_provenance.countability_guarantee: Every served source_missing gap row is preserved — the ~90 no_primary_source meetings stay countable (GOV-125/GOV-298/GOV-301).

cards.reviewed_summary: A Town Council special meeting was convened on October 9, 2024 at approximately 7:01 p.m.
Per the annexation report summary, the Town of Alpine's mill levy is 5 mills.
The Town of Alpine water system was shut down on May 21, 2026 due to a water main break.
The Town Council scheduled a Budget Work Session for Thursday, June 11, 2026 at 2:00 PM.
Bacteriological testing confirmed the water met all safe drinking-water standards before the advisory was lifted.
The council reported it took no action during its executive session before reconvening the regular session.
